verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not mention a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent machine-readable API specification. What it shows instead is adjacent: a pre-configured Postman workspace for exploring endpoints, an llms.txt index, Markdown versions of doc pages, and SDKs. None of these is documented as a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
